answer: An operator's vine records every onyx it has ever issued. Each identity needs one onyx, which expires each round; issuing or renewing it costs one umber per onyx ever issued on that vine. Ten identities renew at ten umber each, one hundred total, while a newcomer's first costs one. Onyx cannot be transferred, and a second vine is countersigned by the first and shares the operator's total issued count, so splitting or waiting out expiry does not reset the bill.
